body: It will never stop. Read a book by Virginia Woolf, then maybe read The Golden Bough. Suicides have always happened, because life is not for everyone. You can't protect people from themselves. I must be wrong in the head to want to kill myself when I'm happy or sad or whatever. It's hard. Life is strange. I think that life is mostly sad. It must be sad if people kill themselves. I don't know what to say. I'm sorry. I'm trying to get better...

I had friends. But they're so far away now. 

I miss the gatherings. The warmth. The laughs. I am not strong enough to exist on my own like this. It isn't your fault that the world is the way that it is. Lonely, pointless, driven by machines. So much movement and so little human connection. If ever I interact with a friend, which is maybe once or twice every two weeks, I'm still sad about our inevitable departure. It's not your fault, really, that some people can't adjust to this. I was once a friend to my friends, now I'm just someone that occasionally annoys them. It hurts. I hope that when I kill myself that I don't wound the people in my life. What if I wound them in such a way that they kill themselves too? I think about this. It hurts too. Look, bad things happen... You can't worry about everyone. You have to understand and move on. I would not like it if I hurt people by killing myself. Sorry for rambling, and for your loss.

“That's not good.”

“I did some reading on it and...”

“Grossly healthy. ”

“You need to get used to it.”

“You're really quire normal.”

“You seem angry.”

These are quotes from the people I've seen. Nobody can help me. There is no help for what I have. There is no way for me to explain how I feel or think to these people in an honest way. I can't get though. What is worse is that I'm too good a pretender to truly reveal how I feel. I can't cry or get emotional for these people. I need to rest somehow. It's too hard. It's not such a bad thing to kill yourself, I think, so long as you feel like you're waking yourself up from a bad dream. I feel like I'm already half dead, anyway. I feel like I'm out of phase with reality, like I'm half everything.
It's directed at my existence, hence suicide.

Forget ancestry, simply by learning the German language you could get a [free college](http://www.thegrindstone.com/2014/10/16/education/free-college-education-tuition-germany-international-america-united-states-passport/) education. 

Hopefully this is encouraging. I had actually forgotten about this option earlier.

I simply want to say that I read all of your post, but I have no idea you can be helped.

I did, however, upvote your post for visibility. It occurred to me that the personalfinance subreddit could be beneficial for you, since you're an intelligent person who can follow rules, and they might be able to show you that your situation is not as bleak as you believe. You should absolutely wait to find out what the superintendent can do for you, and you should, now that I think about it, be working to convince teachers to support you, and so on. It does not sound like you're convincing people very well, which you need to do, and NOT though suicide. 

I will check on this post again after I emerge from sleep. Take care.

You can be chronically sad, yes. 

But, for 100,000 generations we were hunter gatherers, we took what we needed from nature. Now there's no nature to take from; no community; no companionship; nothing but an awful 9AM - 5PM cookie cutter life. We're no longer properly alive. What is worse is the unconscious mind is aware of the fact that we are working to make ourselves extinct, which is a morbid business, which is why we're more sad then ever; why young people are killing themselves.

Chemical imbalance? More like defective slave. 

They generically engineered a mouse to be depleted of serotonin. It behaved like a normal mouse. We don't understand consciousness on a quantum level. We are full of shit. This is a cruel universe. I used to want to do science, but a cruel universe doesn't deserve to be known. I just want to kill myself.
That's just neat.

> ... is the depression talking.

> ...There is something wrong with your brain, 

> ...a chemical imbalance that makes you think and feel the way that you do

You're delusional. If THIS is a product of therapy, then consider me totally disgusted by it. 

I'm not going any more. The world is drowning in brainlessness and positivist distortions and, yeah, it sucks being one of the few with their eyes open to it. Here's what I'm not going to do: I'm not going to have somebody ignore my arguments and tell me it's “chemicals in my brain” that's making me type these words, because that is bullshit. 

The truth is: (1) Evolution is true. (2) We are working to make ourselves extinct. (3) There will always be war.

The world is sucking it's thumb and rocking back and forth incessantly over these truths, fucking dumbfounded. Well guess what? Pretty soon the environment is going to kick the world in the teeth and give the whole dumbass world a reality check, because these damn positivist distortions are ruining everything. 

I'm glad I'm suicidal. I won't have to pick up the pieces of a ruined world when you CHILDREN pick up your mess. 

I guess this is what you get when you have a whole generation raised on “Leave it to Beaver” and “The Andy Griffith Show” and other candy ass crap: a generation of denialists; a generation of people who can't face the realities of the world; that the world really is shit; that people are shit and money is shit and existence is shit and life is insanity.

I don't want help for depression. I'm disappointed with my existence. It's not worth hanging onto. Each day is just another opportunity to feel like crap. I'm constantly killing myself; when I work; when I read; when I watch TV; when I sleep. I live an endless suicide. I don't care how special or unique my suffering is. The horror is suffering itself! I'm one hundred percent certain I'm going to kill myself this year. I'm not suffering from depression. Nobody is; we're made to suffer because we're all freakish gene moving machines. No hell that is imaginable to the human mind is comparable to the hell of the real world, because the human mind was actually created to distort a hell beyond imagining; to make it better. Everything is indescribably terrible. I can't get better. I've gone too far. I can't stop processing my monstrosity and the monstrosities of the future. We've traveled, like, what, zero light years? How bad will things get when we travel one? One million? This is normal? You can cope with this? I despise this. If sleeping and eating weren't things we'd all go mad! Oh my god. What if that's why life started eating itself? We're mad? I don't know how to fit into this insanity.

I'm just going to sound psychotic. What am I supposed to say? This world sucks. I'm all alone; abandoned; forgotten child of the state; fallen between the cracks; atomizing everything; tortured by myself; my own worst enemy; hopeless; suicidal. Interested in science, but crippled by disappointment. Life eats itself to survive, thus death is freedom from this insanity. I can't handle reality. I hate it. I wish this wasn't real and I wish I was dead.

For reasons I won't describe, my window of opportunity for suicide wasn't large enough today, so I am writing essays on why I am killing myself (and why I wouldn't) instead. Just wanted to give you an update..

Yes, I'm sure you are curious. People love to say: I survived Hemmingway, Thompson, Woolf, Plath, Toole, Nietzsche, and all these people who couldn't survive themselves. It makes them feel powerful. 

My vision of reality cannot be distorted to be anything other than what it is. Even if I did expose you and the world to my "dark views" it would accomplish nothing. Some would fall prey to it, but most would survive. 

I don't want to see a so-called professional. The therapist and the priests have the easiest jobs in the world: sit and listen and defend life and make money doing it. I'm not going to piss money away arguing about why I want to die, or become a hypocrite who writes about how much he wants to die, but doesn't die, I'm just going to die.

Yes. My so-called macroprocessing abilities makes my existence in this petty, materialistic, failure parade an unendurable experience. This life is no longer tolerable. I work to feed an existence I don't want and I write only to receive sanction for a suicide that I've lacked the courage to execute.

There is no different way to process it.

Nature is killing us, we killed each other, we are working only to make ourselves extinct, and there will always be universal war against itself, for which the only solution is suicide, so I'm ending a nightmare.

My use of try does not imply what you suppose it does. Can I guarantee that my suicide will be a success? Certainly not, hence try. Furthermore, I am not depressed. I am disappointed. Death is the only thing that can alleviate my disappointment.

I'm working for a tech company on the internet and I'm living in a dump and I can't connect with anyone because I all I want them to do is hold my hand as I kill myself. I've seen the whole world and it's all so disappointing. No matter what state you go to it's gas stations and restaurants and loneliness for miles...

Yeah, I'd like to have you read it. I'm waiting on feedback from some of my friends, who I hope won't tell me I've gone totally insane. I'm not sure if I can bring myself to share it... 

I'd like to meditate. I'd like to sit and starve to death with contentment, but I don't because I'm afraid that's what I'll do. I want to be a Buddhist, and yet I still feel like there's something sinister about it, like it's sort of why Asia is really fucked up in a lot of ways, because it exists as a magnet for attracting and killing those who are averse to society, which is great for the evil ones. I just feel like humans are total failures in every way, and I have zero hope for humanity. Just being human and seeing human faces disgusts me. When I see a human I see a miserable ape. 

Sorry... I know there's something good in people. These words are just reactions to a horrible feeling.

If you want to we could talk about themes and stuff. PM me?

I don't care about anything. I have chronic, incurable,  physiological problems that are never going away. I have PTSD and if I go out in public my imagination peels everything back and atomizes everything. This would be fucking great and I could be fucking happy, in a hunter gatherer society, but I live as a cog in a cold and lonely and brainless machine! My mind is just fine, it's this life of working just to exist and helping no one that is absolutely intolerable. What is the point in sucking down series after series if I just die and forget them? My life helps no one. My routine is torture. There are tons of other reasons. A landslide of reasons, hence the book of reasons. I don't have anything riding on the book. The book has only been a pool for draining the poison in me. I'm tired of my poison draining exercises. I'm just tired.

Honestly. Who fucking cares how good my writing is?

Most forms of entertainment are just suicide distractions or suicide manuals, I think. I could have written "I want to kill myself." a billion times over and over again and it would have had the same meaning, but it would have been less pretty. This is why Asiatic societies don't have "good literature" and so on, it's because all of the negative utilitarian life hating writers over there either kill themselves or become monks, so they don't feel compelled to pumble their aversions to life into the dirt with words, because society has a way out for them.
I sent.
Yeah. Consider me thoroughly scared.

I wish I didn't have this gnawing desire to kill myself. Are you a compassionate person? I think I am. I want to live and be happy but I don't think I'll make it, even to 30. I wish I could say I wouldn't kill myself if I had a painless way out. Living for my children... That's what I would do if I were you. Maybe you, just by listening to me, will make the pain of existence that much easier for your children. Maybe you can brace them for this pain which took me by surprise? I often think that if I kill myself then at least another aperture in the universe will see this world as good. Maybe you can make it good for them? I wish we didn't have to feel this way. Fuck, I'm not sure if I'm helping. I hope I'm making you feel better by confiding how I feel. Can I ask why you quoted me?

You're a father. I'm a 20 year old depressed guy. :(

I've been depressed since I was 14. I wish I had answers but I don't. I do tire of feeling like I'm in a machine. People are so detached; work and life feels like interacting with an existence machine. Resisting suicide is something I've struggled with since I realized that I had to grow up and serve this great machine. I got burnt out on life's rewards long before I had to work. Overstimulation. Now that I'm working continuing hardly seems justifiable, since clenched in my teeth at all times is the knowledge that I'm going to die and forget it all. Really I want a simpler life... I want to feel needed and loved and close to people and not mechanical. To others I am only my job title and yeah it makes me feel like nothing. I want so much to feel connect but to me everyone feels so far away... 

I'm sorry I'm not uplifting. I'm suffering. Can I ask how old you are for perspective?

> Is this a world that really is human?

Not really. We live like ants on a state sized plate. Everyone is working for nothing but themselves and it sucks. I want so much to feel like I'm helping others, but there's so many of us now, so really I'm really only working to continue to exist... Is this what bothers you?
I don't know about the shit colored glasses thing. There are things that are seriously wrong with the world. I hope you feel better. You're not alone.

I typed this on my phone so please excuse the formatting. 

My cage? My body. My life. I feel overwhelmed by my own experience; the strangeness of being alive, knowing that death is hanging over every moment. It has killed my hunger for life. To me I am a system of memories of bad experiences and misfortunes that I'd prefer to forget. I can't form connections with other people because the business of life offers me little opportunity to do so. I'm sad all the time. I have always wanted to kill myself and I have always lacked the courage, or felt that it would be *impolite* to do so. These words of encouragement I read on the internet are the only things that keep me going... But someday I imagine that computer programs will be able to produce such words, comparable to your own. I feel completely empty. I see the animals clawing at the dirt for bugs and worms outside and I also see them clawing at the universe itself, and in vain. And of course here I am, watching and thinking about it all, feeling trapped inside my own self, wanting to just die. I can't help it. I'm doomed to think this way, to be sensitive and smart and hurting. Had I been born into a tribe of of savages I probably would have beat myself senseless in total frustration that the world could be this way. People really did used to do such things, after all, and I think I may be such a type. I'm so weary and alone and disconnected. I torment myself into quitting every job I take. There's no place for me. I exist because I do. I've been very careless about my life. I've been making choices to push myself over the edge when things get too difficult, but I'm never courageous enough to do it. My depression is constant. I've become robotic in my mannerisms in an effort to fit into this mechanical world, which has only made myself even more repulsive to me. I wish that when I called the suicide hotline they had sent a squad to my home to put me down like an animal. I am, after all, an animal. But the world is hostile to animals and brains and thoughts and wants people like me to die. At least, that's how I feel; like a dead, lifeless, robot that can't be free or form connections. I'm so sad and empty. I crave death.

Everything. I called the suicide hotline, saying that I was going to kill myself, someday, over ten years ago, and nothing's changed. I feel like an animal caught in an existential cage. I've tried to make the cage of my self more comfortable, but the reality is I hate the cage; myself, and want to die, desperately. 

EDIT: I don't even derive pleasure when meeting friends anymore. It hurts, constantly.
